summary: 营销所需的数据越来越多，信息过载却可能妨碍决策。文章由销售与研究的关系讲到营销信息系统怎样筛选、传递信息，并强调要按实际用途衡量收集成本。
logic: 回顾营销实践与研究的结合
解释决策需要哪些信息
用信息系统权衡成本和效用

paragraphs.brief: 这还意味着顾客必须看到继续返回商店和所经营的服务提供者的价值。
sentences: For the early practitioners of marketing in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, the business of selling was simply a matter of continually finding new customers.
对于19世纪末和20世纪初早期的市场营销业者来说，销售业务只是不断寻找新客户的问题。
By contrast, marketing managers in the current era recognise the importance of gathering information about the market and about potential customers.
相比之下，当前时代的营销管理人员认识到收集有关市场和潜在客户的信息的重要性。

They recognise that if companies are to be profitable, customers must gain and retain their perceptions of value from the brands they buy over a long time frame, rather than from a single transaction.
他们认识到，如果公司要盈利，客户就必须从他们长期购买的品牌中获取和保持对价值的看法，而不是从单笔交易中获得。
This also means that customers must see value in returning continually to the stores where they shop, as well as to the service providers they deal with.
这还意味着顾客必须看到继续返回商店和所经营的服务提供者的价值。

paragraphs.brief: 营销从业人员和营销科学家从未像现在这样密切合作。
sentences: Marketing practitioners and marketing scientists have never worked more closely than they currently do.
营销从业人员和营销科学家从未像现在这样密切合作。

There are many reasons for this, including the fact that this is the information age where convergence in telecommunications, media and technology is causing old ways to be challenged, and new methods and tools to be tested.
造成这种情况的原因很多，其中包括，在信息时代，电讯、媒体和技术的趋同正在对旧的方法提出质疑，新的方法和工具也有待测试。
Customer expectations have risen as new technologies allow new approaches.
随着新技术允许采用新的方法，客户的期望提高了。

For instance, the subscriber-TV music channel Channel [V] encourages its viewers to sign up for text messages and email alerts that tell them when their favourite artists and songs are about to be broadcast.
例如，订户-TV音乐频道频道[V]鼓励观众报名收听短信和电子邮件提示，告诉他们他们最喜欢的艺术家和歌曲何时即将播出。

Competitive advantage lies in being able to recognise which customers can be given greater attention, not just because they demand it but because it makes commercial sense to provide high levels of product quality and service.
竞争优势在于能够认识到哪些客户可以受到更多的关注，这不仅是因为客户需要，而且因为提供高水平的产品质量和服务在商业上是合情合理的。

paragraphs.brief: 现代营销信息系统依靠信息技术，以便能够收集营销情报，并储存和分析营销研究信息。
sentences: Modern marketing information systems rely on information technology to enable marketing intelligence to be gathered and to store and analyse marketing research information.
现代营销信息系统依靠信息技术，以便能够收集营销情报，并储存和分析营销研究信息。

While some of the information used is gathered by government bodies such as the Australian Bureau of Statistics and Statistics New Zealand, most of it is purposefully gathered by marketing organisations for client companies.
所使用的一些信息是由政府机构收集的，例如澳大利亚统计局和新西兰统计局，但大多数信息是专门由销售组织为客户公司收集的。

In the process, computer technology is used to manipulate the data and then to present the information in such a way that executives can readily identify any problems or issues, and quickly arrive at solutions.
在这一过程中，计算机技术被用来操纵数据，然后以管理人员能够随时发现任何问题的方式提供信息，并迅速找到解决办法。

paragraphs.brief: 为了给客户带来更高的价值和满意度，营销经理几乎每转每转都需要信息。
sentences: In order to produce superior value and satisfaction for customers, marketing managers need information at almost every turn.
为了给客户带来更高的价值和满意度，营销经理几乎每转每转都需要信息。
They need information about customers – end-users and resellers – as well as competitors and governmental and other forces in the marketplace.
他们需要关于客户、最终用户和转售商以及竞争者、政府和其他力量在市场上的信息。
One marketing executive put it this way: ‘To manage a business well is to manage its future; and to manage the future is to manage information.’
一位营销主管这样说：“管理一个商业井就是管理其未来；管理未来就是管理信息。”
Increasingly, marketers are viewing information not just as an input for making better decisions but also as an important strategic asset and marketing tool.
市场人士越来越把信息看成不仅是作出更好决定的一种投入，而且也是一个重要的战略资产和营销工具。
As household incomes increase, choice widens and buyers become better at discriminating, so sellers need information about how buyers respond to different products and advertising campaigns.
随着家庭收入的增加，选择范围扩大，买方在歧视方面变得更好，因此卖方需要了解买方如何应对不同产品和广告宣传。
The supply of information has also increased greatly.
信息供应也大大增加。

It has been suggested by the futurist and best-selling author John Naisbitt that the United States and, by observation, developed countries such as Australia, New Zealand and Singapore are moving from industrial to information-based economies.
未来的畅销作家John Naisbitt指出，美国以及澳大利亚、新西兰和新加坡等发达国家正在从工业型经济转向信息型经济。

These post-industrial economies earn 70–80% of their Gross Domestic Product from services, and have entered what some commentators have termed the ‘Information Age’ or the ‘Information Technology Era’.
这些后工业经济体从服务业中赚取了70-80%的国内生产总值，并进入了某些评论家称之为 " 信息时代 " 或 " 信息技术时代 " 的时代。

paragraphs.brief: 因此，许多营销组织目前正在研究其管理人员的信息需求，并设计信息系统，专门满足这些需求。
sentences: One study found that with all the information now available through supermarket scanners, a packaged-goods product controller is bombarded with one million to one billion new numbers each week.
一项研究发现，根据超市扫描仪提供的所有信息，一个包装货物产品控制器每周被轰炸100万至10亿个新数字。
As Naisbitt points out: ‘Running out of information is not a problem, but drowning in it is.’
正如Naisbitt指出的，“信息流出不是问题，而是淹没在信息中。

Yet marketers frequently complain that they lack information of the right kind but have plenty of the wrong kind, or they claim that marketing information is so widely spread throughout the organisation that it takes great effort to locate even simple facts.
然而，市场人士经常抱怨说，他们缺乏正确的信息，但有太多的错误信息，或者他们声称，销售信息在全组织中广泛传播，因此，他们需要付出很大努力来找出甚至简单的事实。

In addition, subordinates may withhold information they believe will reflect badly on their performance and important information often arrives too late to be useful, or on-time information is not accurate.
此外，下属可能隐瞒他们认为会对其表现产生严重反射的信息，而重要信息往往来得太晚，无法发挥作用，或者实时信息不准确。
So marketing managers need better information.
所以营销经理需要更好的信息
Although marketing organisations have greater capacity to provide managers with information, they often do not use it well.
虽然营销组织有更大的能力向管理人员提供信息，但它们往往不能很好地利用这些信息。
As a result, many marketing organisations are now studying their managers’ information needs and designing information systems specifically to meet those needs.
因此，许多营销组织目前正在研究其管理人员的信息需求，并设计信息系统，专门满足这些需求。

paragraphs.brief: 一个解决办法是使用销售信息系统。
sentences: One solution is to use a Marketing Information System (MIS).
一个解决办法是使用销售信息系统。
This consists of people, equipment and procedures which, when put together, are able to gather, analyse, evaluate and distribute needed, timely and accurate information to marketing decision-makers.
这包括人员、设备和程序，这些设备、设备和程序组合在一起，能够收集、分析、评价和向营销决策者分发所需、及时和准确的信息。
The MIS begins and ends with marketing managers.
管理信息系统由营销经理开始和结束。
First, it interacts with these managers to assess the information needs they have.
首先，它与这些管理人员进行互动，以评估他们的信息需求。
Next, it develops the needed information from internal records, marketing intelligence activities and the research process.
其次，它从内部记录、营销情报活动和研究过程中获取所需信息。
The analysis unit processes the data to make it more useful and, finally, the MIS distributes it to managers in the right form and at the right time to help them make better marketing decisions.
分析股处理数据，使之更有用，最后，管理信息系统以正确的形式和适当时间向管理人员分发数据，帮助他们作出更好的营销决定。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，获取、处理、储存和递送信息的费用可以迅速增加。
sentences: However, the costs of obtaining, processing, storing and delivering information can mount quickly.
然而，获取、处理、储存和递送信息的费用可以迅速增加。
In some cases additional information will do little to change or improve a manager’s decision, or the costs of the information will exceed the returns from the improved decision.
在某些情况下，补充资料对改变或改进管理人员的决定没有多大帮助，否则资料的费用将超过改进后的决定的回报。

For example, if an organisation estimates that launching a new product without any further information will yield a profit of $500,000, then it would be foolish to spend $30,000 for additional information that would increase the profit to only $525,000.
例如，假如一家机构估计，现有信息足以让它推出新产品并赚取 50 万美元，而额外信息只能将利润提高到 52.5 万美元，那么再花 3 万美元购买这些信息就不划算了。
By itself, information is valueless – its value comes from its use.
信息本身毫无价值，其价值来自其使用。

items.en: the fact that there may be too much information to cope with
items.zh: 可能有很多信息无法处理
items.why: F 段说超市扫描数据每周能给一名产品负责人带来数百万至十亿个新数字。用数量举例，是为了说明信息多到难以处理。

items.en: the relevance of generating repeat business
items.zh: 产生重复业务的相关性
items.why: A 段说顾客必须持续感到有价值，才会反复回到同一商店或服务商，说明营销需要争取回头客。
B 段的音乐频道按观众喜爱的歌手和歌曲发送提示，而不是向每人发相同内容，这就是个性化营销的例子。

items.en: an illustration of a situation where commissioning new information research might not be advisable
items.zh: 说明委托进行新的信息研究可能不可取的情况
items.why: H 段用新产品决策的收益与调查费用算账：如果额外研究带来的预期收益不抵费用，委托调查就不划算。

items.en: how the greater wealth of customers enables them to select from a broader range of products
items.zh: 客户的财富越多，他们又如何能够从更广泛的产品中作出选择
items.why: D 段说家庭收入提高后，购买者能从更多商品中选择，也更会作区分，写的正是更富裕如何扩大选择。

items.en: The majority of marketing statistics are gathered by government agencies.
items.zh: 大多数营销统计数据是由政府机构收集的。
items.why: 文中说大多数信息由营销组织收集，非政府机构。与题干“多数由政府收集” 相反。

items.en: The move from an industrial to an information-based economy has happened more quickly in New Zealand than in Australia.
items.zh: 从工业经济向信息经济的转变在新西兰比在澳大利亚发生得更快。
items.why: 新西兰和澳大利亚只是被并列举作转向信息经济的发达国家。文中没有比较两国完成转型的速度。

items.en: Employees sometimes hide information that gives a poor impression of them.
items.zh: 雇员有时隐藏信息，使他们印象不好。
items.why: 下属有时会隐瞒他们认为有损自己工作表现形象的信息，直接对应题干中的隐藏不利信息。

items.en: Managers frequently fail to make good use of the information they receive.
items.zh: 管理人员往往不能很好地利用他们收到的资料。
items.why: 原文说营销组织能向经理提供更多信息，但经理常常没有善加使用。信息的数量和利用效果在这里被明确区分。

items.en: Marketing information has to be used to be valuable.
items.zh: 营销信息必须被利用，以便具有价值。
items.why: 作者明说信息本身没有价值，价值产生于实际应用，直接支持营销信息必须用起来才有价值。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: The marketing information system starts with ________, whose requirements it identifies and to whom it distributes accurate data.
items.zh: 营销信息系统以 ________ 为起点，先弄清他们需要什么，再向他们提供准确的数据。

items.en: The marketing information system must find out the users’ ________.
items.zh: 营销信息系统必须弄清使用者的 ________。

items.en: Information is developed through ________, marketing intelligence activities and the research process.
items.zh: 可通过 ________、市场情报活动和调研过程获取并整理信息。
items.why: 三个来源之一。对应“Developed through:…”.

items.en: Before timely and accurate distribution, the data are processed by the ________.
items.zh: 为使数据能及时、准确地分发出去，须先交由 ________ 处理。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

points: B 段的音乐频道按观众喜爱的歌手和歌曲发送提示，而不是向每人发相同内容，这就是个性化营销的例子。
文中说大多数信息由营销组织收集，非政府机构。与题干“多数由政府收集” 相反。
clauses: They recognise that …, customers must gain and retain their perceptions of value from the brands they buy over a long time frame, rather than from a single transaction.
连接词 if 引出“if companies are to be profitable”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
Competitive advantage lies in being able to recognise which customers can be given greater attention, … but because it makes commercial sense to provide high levels of product quality and service.
连接词 because 引出“not just because they demand it”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
